description: Repairs r-def-cursor-dao/pos-query-*: the fixture was opened read-only, so Updatable read False for every query source; the same shapes opened read-write differ. For each source [SELECT DISTINCT N FROM T ORDER BY N ;; SELECT N, Count(*) AS Cn FROM T GROUP BY N ORDER BY N ;; SELECT TOP 3 ID, N FROM T ORDER BY N DESC, ID ;; SELECT TOP 4 ID, N FROM T ORDER BY N ;; SELECT ID, N FROM T WHERE ID <= 3 UNION SELECT ID + 10, N FROM T WHERE ID > 6 ;; TRANSFORM Count(ID) AS Cn SELECT S FROM T GROUP BY S PIVOT Fl ;; SELECT PA.ID AS PAID, CH.ID AS CHID FROM PA LEFT JOIN CH ON PA.ID = CH.PID ORDER BY PA.ID, CH.ID], as a dynaset and as a snapshot on a writable Database: read Type, Updatable, Bookmarkable, RecordCount, the Fields Count; then BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition, PercentPosition and the value of field 0 at the first row; MoveLast and read the same and RecordCount; MoveNext (past the end) and read; MovePrevious and read; MovePrevious again; MoveFirst, MovePrevious (before the start) and read; MoveFirst, Move 2 and read; Move -1 and read. Nothing is written. Asks the position, count and boundary states and the updatability of a recordset whose source is not a plain table, per requested type, and which requests are refused. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
